title: Stratum usage batch v1
description: Body of POST /api/internal/usage: what each request through a gateway consumed (ADR-0009). Metadata only: never prompts, completions or credentials. Same compatibility rule as the sync contract: adding optional fields is compatible; removing or retyping one is not. The control plane skips records it cannot store and refuses a batch only when the batch itself is malformed.

instance_id.description: The reporting gateway's instance ID. Must match the sync token when present.

id.description: UUID chosen by the gateway; the idempotency key. A record sent again with the same id and ts is stored once.

ts.description: When the request arrived (RFC 3339). Records older than 35 days or more than 5 minutes ahead of the control plane's clock are skipped.

request_id.description: The X-Request-Id the gateway returned to the client.

key_id.description: ID of the API key as the sync sent it: a user ID, or agent:<agent id>.

user_id.description: Optional, from 0.4. The person a key that delegates acted for (X-Stratum-User), as the people directory names them; the usage is theirs. Ignored unless that person belongs to the gateway's organization.

team_id.description: Team whose policy applied: the key's, or the person's when the key acted for one. Ignored unless it belongs to the gateway's organization.

model.description: Model as sent to the provider (without the provider prefix).

status.description: HTTP status returned to the client (499: the client went away).

reason.description: Short code: ok, or why the request failed or was refused.

upstream_ms.description: Time until the provider's response headers.

tokens_in.description: Every input token, the prompt cache's included, as providers count them on their usage pages.

tokens_cache_write.description: Optional, from 1.0. The part of tokens_in written to the provider's prompt cache (Anthropic's cache_creation_input_tokens), priced apart.

tokens_cache_read.description: Optional, from 1.0. The part of tokens_in read from the provider's prompt cache (Anthropic's cache_read_input_tokens, OpenAI's prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens), priced apart.

content_flags.description: Kinds of sensitive data the policy's PII/DLP rules found (never the data).

labels.description: Optional, from 0.4. Labels the application put on the request (X-Stratum-Labels), such as a topic. Apart from content_flags: never counted as a finding.

alias.description: Optional, from 0.6. The route the request asked for (stratum/<name>, without the prefix), so the control plane can tell when a policy's default route is falling back (label routed_fallback).

images.description: Optional, from 0.8 (ADR-0018). Images an image generation made, priced per image.

audio_seconds.description: Optional, from 0.8 (ADR-0018). Seconds of audio a transcription heard, priced per minute.

task.description: Optional, from 0.9 (ADR-0019). The X-Stratum-Task the request named, or the task an outcome ends.

outcome.description: Optional, from 0.9 (ADR-0019). Present only on a task's end (POST /v1/stratum/tasks/{task}), which is no request: provider "stratum", model "task", reason "task_outcome", no tokens. A control plane older than 0.9 stores it as a request of stratum/task.

outcome_reason.description: Optional, from 0.9 (ADR-0019). Why the task ended so, as a code.

agent_version.description: Optional, from 0.9 (ADR-0019). The version of its instructions the application named (X-Stratum-Agent-Version), on a request or a task's end.
